moisture_pct.quote: Both versions contain 45% fat in the dry matter and 42% moisture

fat_pct.quote: Both versions contain 45% fat in the dry matter and 42% moisture

ph.quote: curds are transferred to molds and pressed, finally reaching a pH value of 5.4–5.5

ammonia.reason: Modest deamination during 6-mo ripening with dry natural rind venting NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Tyr/Trp catabolism to p-cresol/indole plus raw-milk farm microbiota in rind.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic alpha-s1 casein peptides from chymosin incompletely debittered by starter peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; only background 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from lipase beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose/galactose plus Lys residues give moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Mesophilic Lactococcus citrate to diacetyl/acetoin plus C4-C12 lactones from ewe milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Ovine rennet pregastric lipase liberating butyric 110 mg/kg plus hexanoic/octanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Low 42% moisture firm matrix limits fat coalescence despite 45% FDM ewes fat.

crumbliness.reason: pH 5.4 calcium solubilization plus prolonged proteolysis giving short friable body.

firmness.reason: 42% moisture pressed curd with 6-mo evaporation and crosslinked paracasein network.

floral_honey.reason: Phe catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol plus pasture terpenes from Churra milk.

fruity.reason: NSLAB esterases esterifying ethanol with butyric/hexanoic to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk short and branched-chain FFA C6-C10, 4-methyloctanoic via rennet lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Leu/Ile/Val Strecker aldehydes like 3-methylbutanal from 6-mo proteolysis and ripening.

melt.reason: Dehydrated aged paracasein with calcium loss and brine salt limits flow, softens more than flows.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Limited linoleate oxidation to 1-octen-3-ol in low-moisture pressed interior.

oil_off.reason: About 26% fat in tight aged matrix releases moderate free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step; no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: High acetic acid 1102 mg/kg at 4-mo plus lactic acid from mesophilic starter at pH 5.4.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel with no hot-water kneading to align casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low Met catabolism to methanethiol/DMS and mild 37C cook, no thermophilic sulfur.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; faint sweetness from glycerol, Ala/Pro and sheep-fat lactones.

umami.reason: Chymosin/plasmin plus Lactococcus peptidases releasing Glu peptides enhanced by 2.2% NaCl.
